cases.source: SkillCanary observed regression: import only accepted one hand-written summary shape
cases.change: Add auto-detection for skillgrade summary and passed/total aliases.
cases.notes: The importer must convert real runner summaries without manual editing.

cases.source: SkillCanary observed regression: benchmark artifacts used baseline/with_skill and nested passed/total counters
cases.change: Add agent-skills-eval aliases and auto detection.
cases.notes: The importer must map without_skill/with_skill to before/after.

cases.source: SkillCanary observed regression: promptfoo stats.successes/failures were not an accepted evidence shape
cases.change: Add promptfoo stats and trial-array adapters.
cases.notes: The importer must consume promptfoo result summaries.

cases.source: SkillCanary observed regression: evidence schemas existed but no run/query layer
cases.change: Add JSONL-backed eval-run and eval-case-score materialization.
cases.notes: Evidence must become queryable before a dashboard is considered.

cases.source: SkillCanary observed regression: no way to find a FAIL->PASS or COUNT->0 score by skill
cases.change: Add query filters over the materialized case-score table.
cases.notes: A stored transition must be retrievable as evidence.

cases.source: SkillCanary observed regression: error-budget rule existed without metrics
cases.change: Derive correction, rework and tool-error totals from outcome records.
cases.notes: A team within budget should not be told to stop collecting incidents.

cases.source: SkillCanary observed regression: stop-work rule had no measurable trigger
cases.change: Fail the check when a window exceeds correction, rework or tool-error budgets.
cases.notes: An exhausted budget must stop endless skill edits and require new incidents.

cases.source: SkillCanary observed regression: hook rules had no preflight validation
cases.change: Validate hook rule ids, reasons, regex patterns and duplicates.
cases.notes: A valid local rule file must be accepted before host integration.

cases.source: SkillCanary observed regression: an invalid regex silently became an allow
cases.change: Make invalid hook regex a hard doctor failure.
cases.notes: A broken guard must fail closed during configuration validation.

cases.source: SkillCanary observed regression: held-out cases could be used as tuning targets
cases.change: Reject any target case carrying held_out=true.
cases.notes: Held-out evidence must not be optimized against.

cases.source: SkillCanary observed regression: deterministic evidence could claim COUNT->0 without decreasing
cases.change: Require count_before > count_after and count_after=0 for deterministic targets.
cases.notes: The gate must reject a flat deterministic result.

cases.source: SkillCanary observed regression: case-target changes passed without cases.json
cases.change: Require cases.json unless drafting mode is explicit.
cases.notes: A case cannot be validated if the case ledger is absent.

cases.source: SkillCanary observed gap: modules were supported ad hoc without a capability registry
cases.change: Add a canonical adapter registry and doctor.
cases.notes: Adapters must declare their contract and permissions.

cases.source: SkillCanary observed gap: policy algorithm changes had no deterministic lab
cases.change: Add deterministic comparison of greedy, UCB, Thompson and hybrid policies.
cases.notes: Exploratory algorithms need reproducible simulation.

cases.source: SkillCanary observed gap: advice candidates had no acquisition priority
cases.change: Add information-value-based active case ranking.
cases.notes: High-severity deterministic candidates must rank first.

cases.source: SkillCanary observed gap: non-stationary outcome distributions could poison policy history
cases.change: Add CUSUM change-point detection.
cases.notes: A change point must stop silent reuse of stale history.

cases.source: Observed gap: final-answer evidence could not explain where the agent failed
cases.change: Add six-dimensional trajectory analysis.
cases.notes: Trajectory dimensions must remain independent.

cases.source: Observed gap: pass@1 hid unstable repeated runs
cases.change: Add pass^k and confidence intervals.
cases.notes: Reliability must be estimated across repeated trials.

cases.source: Observed gap: uncalibrated LLM judges were treated as release gates
cases.change: Add Cohen kappa calibration and deterministic-first grader planning.
cases.notes: Judges below the calibration threshold must not gate release.

cases.source: Observed industry failure: multi-agent used for deterministic workflows
cases.change: Add deterministic/workflow/agent/human execution-mode audit.
cases.notes: Agent overuse and missing human approval must be rejected.

cases.source: Observed gap: capability and regression cases were mixed
cases.change: Add golden-set acquisition scoring and suite classification.
cases.notes: Golden sets must prioritize information value.
